conviction_note: Q3 revenue (~EUR 110m) and production (~23,500 BOEPD) were pre-released by the 27 Oct ad-hoc, so the release turns on whether the EUR 420-440m EBITDA guide holds with WTI at ~$87 against the $95 it assumes for Nov-Dec. That gap is worth roughly EUR 8m (~2% of EBITDA), and no ad-hoc has been filed to cut the guide, so a large change is unlikely. The findings add up to a small negative (-0.5). The scaled number is a near-coin-flip (p_up 51) on a large abs move (5.5%), sized for a thin, 58%-vol name that fell ~11% on 16 Nov with no company news. The two numbers differ in sign because the only thing pulling p_up above 50 is a mean-reversion prior after that unexplained drop. I filed that drop at 0, because an unexplained drawdown is not a finding.

Q3/9M EBITDA, net income and EPS. Revenue is pre-released and guidance implies Q3 EBITDA of roughly EUR 115-125m (about EUR 30m of it from the July Almonty sales). There is no consensus to beat, so I expect this to be neutral.
Accounting for the Almonty dispute: possibly an allowance on the ~EUR 10m overdue loans. Small one-off, slight negative if it appears.
unknown. A new buyback is possible: the CEO said on 3 Aug that further programmes would be examined, and the stock is ~25% below the EUR 90.03 average of the last one. Slight positive if it comes.
unknown. Capex of EUR 320-340m against liquidity of EUR 133m at 30 June plus Almonty proceeds. Net debt could worry the market at lower oil.

findings.finding: The raised FY2026 guide (EBITDA EUR 420-440m) assumes WTI $95 for Nov-Dec, but the Dec-26 WTI contract settled $86.88 on 16 Nov, so the release is more likely to confirm the lower end than the midpoint. The gap is roughly EUR 8m, or ~2% of EBITDA: ~26,000 BOEPD at ~70% oil over 61 days, partly offset by the ~$73 hedges.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raises moved the stock +3.07% (22 Jul 2026), +1.86% (5 Aug 2026) and +3.89% (27 Oct 2026). Q3 2025, which kept the guide at the upper end with no raise, saw -2.59% (14 Nov 2025). Yahoo daily closes.

findings.why_not_priced: The oil move is public, and the stock has fallen ~25% since 30 Oct while WTI fell ~16%, so most of this is priced. What is not settled is the company's own wording on the guide. There is no consensus, and no ad-hoc cut has been filed; a material cut would need one under MAR. That points to a confirmation, which limits the downside of this finding.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly against the baseline lean (+0.92, which is just the -18% run-up read as reversal): they are a small negative on the oil assumption. That lean is also the free control, and the 16 Nov no-news drop that would argue for reversal is sized at 0, so the scaled number sits near zero.
language_note: The German wallstreet-online item of 16 Nov was the only source stating explicitly that the -13%/-15% intraday drop had no company trigger and outran BP, Equinor and ENI; English sources carried nothing on the day.

The German aktiencheck preview (15 Nov) was the only preview found. It frames the print as about profit, cost per barrel, hedging and the Q4/2027 outlook, and notes that no public whisper numbers exist.
The company's German ad-hoc and corporate-news originals carried the same numbers as the English EQS versions. The German was used for quotes, not for extra facts.
German press (Börse Express, goldesel, boerse-express) carried the ~5.5m remaining Almonty shares and the analyst targets; English sources did not.
lessons_applied: "The drawdown has no cause in the filings is worth 0": the 16 Nov no-news drop (positioning finding) cut from +1.0 to 0.0, and its weight in p_up removed (p_up 54 to 51).
"A one_off with no stated path to the guide is sized at a fraction": the Almonty receivables finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2.
"Macro-to-company transmission / inference is a hypothesis": the buyback finding, which has no announcement behind it, cut from +0.4 to +0.3.

"Understatement is the systematic error; size the move on what is new": abs_move_pct raised from 5.0 to 5.5 for a thin, 58%-vol name after an 11% no-news drop, even though the period is pre-released (base ~3%).
"A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0": confirmed that no finding rests on the pre-released Q3 revenue or production, and both are listed as rejected duplicates.
